description: This file defines a React component for the notes page in a frontend application. It manages note creation, navigation, and displays a list of notes with filtering options.

methods.name: NotesPage
methods.description: React functional component that renders the notes page with functionality to create new notes and list existing notes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Async function triggered when user clicks the 'New Note' button; creates a new note with optional tag and navigates to its page.
